NewsArticle.Title: The Contest of Light and Chaos Begins
NewsArticle.Content: The sides have chosen their Champions, and these, in turn, have chosen their supporters. And now the first quest is underway. As Aislings enter Temuair, a select few will find in their possession a Chrysalis - a round crystal that represents the spark that is in all Aislings. The sides must collect them and whichever side has the most at the end of one Double Moon has scored the first victory in this contest.
